title: Hearty Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with chicken, shallots, and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the shallots and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend, chicken broth, and water to the tagine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the tagine at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the meat is tender.
Season the tagine with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
